The binding judgment uses the pattern syntax from given.patterns and the slot descriptions/environments from given.typing.environments. BindingTyped.variable preserves the result type and requires a fresh variable. BindingTyped.unpack checks the nominal class, a permutation of every declared field, distinct fresh destinations, and FieldBindings for every field. fieldDescription returns none-as-slot for known negative fields, focus for positive fields, and no result for an unknown field. Thus an initialized child may carry a partial interior view, while an unknown direct field prevents unpacking; no requirement for all descendants to be known has slipped into the rule.
